描述_EN: the monochrome band is adorned with a geometric network of small rectangular triangles, and edged with an ecru border. two fragments of a wide, angled strip of monochrome wine-red tapestry set in a linen ground cloth. the bottom of fragment 2 features a square in reserve, into which a rhombus is inscribed, hosting in its center an eight-petal floral motif traced with a flying shuttle. in each spandrel of the square are large lozenges stamped with a small ecru dot in the center, and framed by two small lozenges on either side.
描述_ZN: 单色条纹上装饰着用飞梭制作的几何网络，边上是由小矩形三角形组成的灰褐色边框。 两块宽角度的单色酒糟挂毯的碎片，被包裹在亚麻底布中。 碎片2的下部有一个预留的方形，里面有一个菱形，中间有一个八瓣花的图案，用梭子描画。 在广场的每个横幅上都放置了大的粘贴物，中间印有一个小的赤褐色圆点，并以放置在两侧的两个小粘贴物为框架。
时期: 埃及 罗马统治时期；拜占庭统治时期
